services.desc: Nestled on the shores of Lake Superior in Bayfield, Wisconsin, lies the Big Top Chautauqua. This haven for performing arts boasts a unique atmosphere - a 900-seat, all-canvas tent theater that evokes a sense of nostalgia. Since 1986, the Big Top has been a summer staple, hosting a vibrant mix of artists. From legendary country music icons like Johnny Cash and Willie Nelson to contemporary performers and local talents, the Big Top offers a diverse lineup that caters to a wide range of interests.
